map.实心圆截面抗扭特性（本页代码口径）：极惯性矩 J = π×d⁴÷32（m⁴）、抗: Torsional properties of a solid circular section (code convention of this page): polar moment of inertia J = π×d⁴ ÷ 32 (m⁴), torsional section modulus Wt = π×d³ ÷ 16 (m³), second moment of area I = π×d⁴ ÷ 64 (m⁴); unit conversion: J and I ×10¹² for mm⁴, Wt ×10⁹ for mm³. Validation: d is required; an empty value returns "Please enter the necessary parameters before calculating." and stops (no 0 fallback). Criterion: no fixed grading; J scales with d⁴ (a 10% diameter increase raises torsional stiffness by about 46%), and Wt governs the maximum torsional shear stress.
